paper_title: Stellar limits on scalars from electron-nucleus bremsstrahlung
notes: Stellar (white-dwarf luminosity function) energy-loss bound on Yukawa couplings of baryophilic (g_B) and leptophilic (g_L) scalars via electron-nucleus bremsstrahlung. Main WD bounds: g_B<~7e-13 (from alpha_B<3.4e-26) and g_L<~4e-16 (from alpha_e<1.2e-32), valid for m_phi<~1 keV; for m_phi<~0.5 eV fifth-force experiments dominate. Reported here is the baryophilic (ScalarNucleon) bound as a mass-independent horizontal line over ~1e-3 to 1e3 eV. NOTE: paper constrains BOTH a nucleon (baryophilic, ScalarNucleon/ScalarBaryon) coupling AND an electron (leptophilic, ScalarElectron) coupling g_L<~4e-16; could equally be extracted as ScalarElectron, hence reduced confidence.
